scenarios.title: A｜希望稍微修改
scenarios.setting: 理发基本完成，理发师让玩家确认效果。

turns.prompt: 你想请理发师稍微调整已剪好的发型，会怎么说？

choices.text: It looks good. Could you take a little more off the sides?

feedback.naturalExpression: It looks good. Could you take a little more off the sides?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I like it. Could you shorten the back just a bit more?

feedback.naturalExpression: I like it. Could you shorten the back just a bit more?
feedback.explanation: “I like”直接分享喜好，后面说出具体类别，能给对方继续聊的话题。

choices.text: Could you trim this part a little more?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you trim this part a little more?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: It’s almost perfect. I’d just like this side a little shorter.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s almost perfect. I’d just like this side a little shorter.
feedback.explanation: “a little”表示少量或轻微程度，适合表达希望只作小幅调整。

choices.text: Can you cut here more little?

feedback.naturalExpression: It looks good. Could you take a little more off the sides?
feedback.explanation: “more little”不是正确比较形式；理发想再短一点，可说“a little shorter”，并指出部位。

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, that’s perfect.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, that’s perfect.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Maybe just a tiny bit more.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe just a tiny bit more.
feedback.explanation: “just a tiny bit more”明确只再修一点点，避免被理解成大幅剪短。

choices.text: Actually, that’s enough. I don’t want it any shorter.

feedback.naturalExpression: Actually, that’s enough. I don’t want it any shorter.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Much better. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Much better. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Yeah, that’s exactly what I wanted.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, that’s exactly what I wanted.
feedback.explanation: “that’s exactly what”表示刚提供的内容正好符合自己的需要，可以结束进一步确认。

scenarios.title: B｜效果不满意
scenarios.setting: 在“理发结果有问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“效果不满意”。

turns.text: All done. What do you think?

turns.prompt: 关于「理发结果有问题」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I think it’s a little shorter than I expected.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think it’s a little shorter than I expected.
feedback.explanation: “than I expected”把实际结果与自己的预期作比较，能清楚说明差异。

choices.text: I’m not completely happy with the way the front looks.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not completely happy with the way the front looks.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: This isn’t quite what I had in mind.

feedback.naturalExpression: This isn’t quite what I had in mind.
feedback.explanation: “had in mind”指心里原本设想的样子，适合说明实际结果与预期的差别。

choices.text: I was hoping to keep more length on top.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was hoping to keep more length on top.
feedback.explanation: 用过去式开头缓和请求，表达试探或期待，而不是要求对方必须照办。

choices.text: I don’t like it. You cut it wrong.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I think it’s a little shorter than I expected.
feedback.explanation: “wrong”没指出问题所在；说明哪部分过短或与参考图不同，理发师才好判断怎样调整。

turns.text: I’m sorry about that. Which part are you unhappy with?

turns.prompt: 关于「理发结果有问题」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: The sides are much shorter than I wanted.

feedback.naturalExpression: The sides are much shorter than I wanted.
feedback.explanation: 比较实际长度与原先要求，指出两侧剪得过短这一具体问题。

choices.text: The front looks a little uneven to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: The front looks a little uneven to me.
feedback.explanation: “a little”表示少量或轻微程度，适合表达希望只作小幅调整。

choices.text: I think this side is shorter than the other one.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think this side is shorter than the other one.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I was expecting it to look more like the photo I showed you.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was expecting it to look more like the photo I showed you.
feedback.explanation: 以之前提供的照片为参照说明预期，便于讨论哪里需要调整。

turns.text: I see what you mean. Let me see what I can do.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. I’d appreciate that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’d appreciate that.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。

choices.text: Could we adjust it without taking off too much more?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could we adjust it without taking off too much more?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: I’d rather not have it any shorter if possible.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather not have it any shorter if possible.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

scenarios.title: C｜与理发师沟通
scenarios.setting: 玩家在理发过程中发现效果正在偏离预期，及时叫停。

turns.text: Sorry, could we pause for a second?

turns.prompt: 关于「理发结果有问题」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I think this side is getting a little shorter than I wanted.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think this side is getting a little shorter than I wanted.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Could we keep a bit more length from here on?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could we keep a bit more length from here on?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: I just want to make sure we’re not taking too much off.

feedback.naturalExpression: I just want to make sure we’re not taking too much off.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: Could I show you the reference photo again?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I show you the reference photo again?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: You are cutting too much hair.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I think this side is getting a little shorter than I wanted.
feedback.explanation: 这句能及时说明剪得太多；补充想保留的长度，可让理发师立即知道应如何调整。

turns.text: Sure. I thought you wanted it about this short.

turns.prompt: 你想澄清自己希望保留的头发长度，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sorry if I wasn’t clear. I’d like it a little longer than that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry if I wasn’t clear. I’d like it a little longer than that.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I may not have explained it very well. I meant just a light trim.

feedback.naturalExpression: I may not have explained it very well. I meant just a light trim.
feedback.explanation: “I meant”澄清自己原本想表达或想做的事，适合纠正误会。

choices.text: The length on top is good. It’s mainly the sides I’m worried about.

feedback.naturalExpression: The length on top is good. It’s mainly the sides I’m worried about.
feedback.explanation: 明确说出担心之处，方便对方针对顾虑解释；没有把担心直接说成已发生的事实。

choices.text: Could we leave the rest a little longer?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could we leave the rest a little longer?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

turns.text: Absolutely. I’ll take off less from the other side.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Perfect. Thanks for checking with me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Thanks for checking with me.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Great. That sounds much closer to what I wanted.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. That sounds much closer to what I wanted.
feedback.explanation: 先回应对方刚给的信息或建议，再接着说明自己的想法，让话题顺着当前内容继续。
